extractions.content: Can the codebase's capabilities be expanded without relying on external dependencies?
No external dependencies should be added to achieve the goal.
Identify existing features or modules that can be repurposed or improved.
Optimize existing code to better handle expected new loads without external additions.
Educate the team on advanced coding practices to unlock potential in current codebase.
